verdict.rationale: Honeycomb has a public pricing page listing a free tier with event volume and metrics data point caps (honeycomb-docs-13, honeycomb-docs-28, honeycomb-docs-29), suggesting some self-serve cost transparency without contacting sales. However, the evidence never shows actual per-signal dollar rates (e.g., $/million events or spans) for paid tiers, nor confirms whether higher-usage tiers require sales contact, so an SRE cannot fully model costs from what's shown.  missing for 10: explicit $ per-event/span pricing figures, confirmation that all paid tiers are self-serve without sales engagement, cost calculator or usage-based rate card.
